subject: HHS FDA - Integrated Social Media Management Services - MRAS
requirement_summary: Cloud-hosted integrated social media management tool with social media listening, Boolean search, sentiment analysis, automated reports/digests. SOC 2 certified. 1-15 users.

subject: NCUA - Liquidating Records Management - MRAS
requirement_summary: IT solution to load, maintain, track communications and manage credit union liquidation activities using near real-time data from multiple sources.

subject: Reminder: GSA OHRM - Mentoring Platform - MRAS
requirement_summary: FedRAMP Certified SaaS platform to administer enterprise mentoring programs. Must be FedRAMP Certified at GSA-approved impact level. Supports mentoring circles, cohort programs, peer/reverse/flash mentoring.

subject: Reminder: DOT - FTA Procurement Closeout Support - MRAS
requirement_summary: Procurement closeout support services for FTA Office of Acquisition Management. Responsible for closing out procurement actions associated with Contracts.

subject: Reminder: VA - National Office Supply Program - MRAS
requirement_summary: National Office Supply Program (BOC 2620/2625): contractor-managed VA-governed ordering portal, catalog governance, EDI transactions, approval workflows, mandatory-source compliance, supplier coordination, delivery, reporting, help desk VA-wide.
